diagnosis_summary: RC2-PRODCARDS3AO retry frames are visually unacceptable due to missing identity conditioning and suboptimal prompt composition. The workflow used for generation was a basic txt2img pipeline without SDXL FaceID adapter or LoRA connected, despite these components being present in the system.

640x480_artifact_audit.explanation: Operator reported seeing 640x480 frames, but audit found only 1344x768 frames in current output. Operator may have seen stale/old frames from previous generation or a different preview. Resolution gate successfully prevented 640x480 generation in RC2-PRODCARDS3AO.

root_causes_identified.description: SDXL FaceID adapter (ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl.bin) exists in system but is NOT connected in the submitted workflow. No IPAdapterAdvanced node present in workflow graph.
root_causes_identified.impact: Identity conditioning completely absent from generation, resulting in weak or no face preservation

root_causes_identified.description: SDXL FaceID LoRA (ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl_lora.safetensors) exists in system but is NOT loaded in the submitted workflow. LoraLoader node 10 has empty lora_stack.
root_causes_identified.impact: No LoRA conditioning to support FaceID adapter, further reducing identity preservation

root_causes_identified.description: Positive prompt contains 'sun-dappled', 'soft golden light', 'dreamlike atmosphere' which create haze/fog effects that reduce contrast and detail.
root_causes_identified.impact: Heavy haze/fog/gray veil destroying detail and contrast, weak forest/environment detail

root_causes_identified.description: Prompt describes 'standing in forest clearing', 'gazing at distant mountain peak' which creates wide landscape composition with distant face.
root_causes_identified.impact: Face too small/distant for identity validation, composition unsuitable for FaceID identity proof

root_causes_identified.description: Workflow template used for generation does not include identity conditioning nodes. This is a template/workflow selection issue, not a file availability issue.
root_causes_identified.impact: All identity conditioning components are bypassed despite being correctly installed in the system

corrective_actions_required.description: Update workflow template to include IPAdapterAdvanced node with SDXL FaceID adapter connection
details: Add IPAdapterAdvanced node to workflow graph
Connect SDXL FaceID adapter (ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl.bin) to IPAdapterAdvanced node
Load SDXL FaceID LoRA (ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl_lora.safetensors) in LoraLoader
Connect LoraLoader output to model conditioning
Connect reference image to IPAdapterAdvanced node
Set appropriate IPAdapter weight (start with 0.6-0.8)

corrective_actions_required.description: Reduce/remove heavy haze/fog/veil terms from prompt
details: Remove 'sun-dappled', 'soft golden light', 'dreamlike atmosphere'
Replace with 'sharp forest detail', 'crisp lighting', 'high contrast'
Add 'clear atmosphere', 'vibrant colors', 'sharp focus'

corrective_actions_required.description: Require medium close-up / face visible for identity validation
details: Change composition from wide landscape to medium close-up
Require visible face / medium shot
Remove 'distant mountain peak', replace with 'face clearly visible'
Add 'medium shot', 'close-up on face', 'identity validation composition'

corrective_actions_required.description: Split into identity validation frame and scene frame
details: Identity validation frame: medium close-up / face visible
Scene frame: landscape environment shot (optional, after identity validated)

corrective_actions_required.description: Require identity wiring proof before next retry
details: SDXL FaceID adapter present in workflow
SDXL FaceID LoRA loaded in workflow
Adapter and LoRA actually connected in graph
Reference image actually used
Face/identity conditioning strength recorded
Workflow audit must pass before retry_generate_frames is allowed

next_retry_blocked_until: Corrective plan is reviewed and workflow template is updated with identity conditioning
quality_targets: Face clearly visible at medium close-up distance
Identity preserved through SDXL FaceID conditioning
Composition suitable for FaceID identity validation
verification_required: SDXL FaceID adapter file path correctly specified
SDXL FaceID LoRA file path correctly specified
IPAdapter weight set to appropriate value (0.6-0.8)
blocking_conditions: Do NOT run ComfyUI until corrective plan is approved
Do NOT generate new frames until workflow template is fixed
Do NOT execute retry_generate_frames until identity wiring is proven
Do NOT run QA until frames pass visual inspection
Do NOT assemble scene until identity is validated
